decisions.reason: CVE-2026-87886 in Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel/Plesk. High-severity (CVSS 7.8) local privilege escalation with targeted exploitation observed in the wild. Affects shared hosting and managed server environments.

CVE-2026-87886.evidence: Acronis reports targeted exploitation of the local privilege escalation vulnerability in the wild

decisions.reason: CVE-2026-23980 is a SQL injection in Apache Superset prior to 6.0.0. Authenticated users with read access can trigger error-based injection via sqlExpression and where parameters. Public PoC released, Superset commonly connects to enterprise databases with sensitive data.

CVE-2026-23980.evidence: Public proof-of-concept exploit released on Exploit-DB; SQL injection can leak database structure information

decisions.reason: WSO2 API Manager CVE-2026-5430 (CVSS 9.8) JWT authentication bypass under active exploitation. Attackers forge admin tokens via improper validation. This is the most specific event for this story.
Oracle September 2026 Critical Patch Update covers 800+ vulnerabilities across Oracle products. Major Patch Tuesday release that enterprise security teams need to track.

decisions.story_title: Noodle RAT modular backdoor maintains persistent access across Asia-Pacific targets
decisions.reason: Noodle RAT (also tracked as ANGRYREBEL) is a modular backdoor used by Chinese-speaking threat groups including Iron Tiger, Calypso APT, and Rocke. Uses scheduled tasks, cron jobs, process spoofing for persistence on Windows and Linux. Targets Thailand, India, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan.

decisions.story_title: PAPERMILL threat cluster deploys VenomRAT via ISO bypass of Windows Mark-of-the-Web
decisions.reason: PAPERMILL uses tax-audit phishing emails with ISO attachments to deliver VenomRAT. The ISO bypasses Mark-of-the-Web protections, then uses DLL sideloading through a signed Notepad++ binary. Campaign passed SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks.

decisions.story_title: APT groups hide PeckBirdy C2 infrastructure behind Chinese casino and adult websites
decisions.reason: China-aligned APTs use low-quality Chinese casino and adult sites to conceal PeckBirdy malware C2 infrastructure. JScript-based framework with WebSocket communications. Active since at least 2023 targeting corporate and government organizations across Asia.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-42167 ProFTPD mod_sql RCE public exploit released
decisions.reason: Public exploit for CVE-2026-42167, a ProFTPD mod_sql vulnerability, is now available on Exploit-DB. The vulnerability has a CVSS v3.1 score and enables remote code execution.

decisions.story_title: Malofee Linux implant returns with new variants
decisions.reason: Malofee (also known as Melofee) is a Linux implant that has returned with new evolved variants. Source is French-language Stormshield research. Worth covering as an active Linux threat.

decisions.story_title: Vwork Android malware clones banking apps to evade detection
decisions.reason: Group-IB uncovered the Gigabud Vwork Android malware chain that clones legitimate banking apps to evade bank detection mechanisms. Financially motivated threat targeting mobile banking users.

decisions.story_title: Google patches actively exploited Android zero-day on Pixel devices
decisions.reason: Google has fixed an actively exploited Android zero-day affecting Pixel devices. Active exploitation of a zero-day on a major mobile platform is a high-priority security event.
